actions: Reviewed PR #19 against Issue #18's 13 acceptance criteria, downloaded and inspected the browser-evidence screenshots, posted a per-criterion review comment, and squash-merged it (Issue #18 closed)

Weighed two Codex P2 findings (week panel outside the <main> landmark; 'This Week' heading mislabels a non-current week), accepted both as real, and recorded in the review that they are folded into the next Issue rather than blocking the merge

Created Issue #20 'feat: deadlines with approaching-work surfacing' labelled ready, covering the last unbuilt GOAL.md section plus the two accepted Codex fixes, with 15 testable acceptance criteria and explicit out-of-scope
agent_report.summary: Merged PR #19 (weekly goals and week progress) after verifying all 13 of Issue #18's acceptance criteria against green CI, 42 passing Playwright tests, and the CI-published screenshots at 360px and 1280px; that closes the Weekly Awareness section of GOAL.md. Two Codex review findings were accepted as genuine but non-blocking for this Issue's criteria and carried forward instead of bouncing the PR. With work in flight back to zero, I created Issue #20 for deadlines and approaching-work surfacing — the last unbuilt GOAL.md section — deliberately leaving carry-forward of unfinished work to a following Issue so each stays one reviewable PR, and folding the two Codex fixes into it. The project is not DONE: deadlines, carry-forward, and day notes are still absent.
